name: football-league-management-system
description: Football League Management, Public Player Registration & Live Player Auction System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,ADMIN,PLAYER-REG" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:player"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../admin-dashboard && npm run build && cd ../player-registration && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../admin-dashboard && npm install && cd ../player-registration && npm install

author: Football League Management Team
